The only relief sought in this application is to direct the learned
Sessions Court to prepone hearing of the application for cancellation of bail
preferred by the applicant which has been adjourned to 14 th August 2023.
2. The Respondent No.1

was granted bail by the Sessions Court vide
order dated 16th September 2021 on certain terms and conditions which
includes not to tamper with the prosecution witnesses in any way.
3. The applicant is the original complainant.
She preferred application for cancellation of bail before the Sessions Court on the ground that the Respondent No.1 has been continuously harassing her after he was released on bail.
The said application was preferred on 24 th December 2021.

The application for cancellation of bail is required to be heard expeditiously.
5. Learned Advocate for Respondent No.1 submitted that, the Respondent No.1 is defending the application for cancellation of bail.
Learned Sessions Judge has adjourned the application on 14 th August 2023 and the Investigating Officer is directed to conduct the inquiry with regard to the alleged harassment to the complainant.
